verdict.rationale: Spline exposes programmatic surfaces (Code API, Real-time API, webhooks, an MCP server), so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for this product. The evidence never mentions API version numbers, stability guarantees, or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. The 'Version History' feature covers saved design-file versions, not API versioning, so it does not count here.
